create_cached_task_with_taskinfra: create a pydantic model with TaskInfra to cache and optionally run methods on a Slurm cluster
submit_async_job_with_submitinfra: submit an asynchronous job via SubmitInfra that runs a method on a cluster without caching results
run_job_array_with_taskinfra: run multiple tasks as a Slurm job array using TaskInfra job_array context manager
clear_cached_job_with_taskinfra: clear a cached job and cancel any running submission using TaskInfra clear_job method
check_task_status_with_taskinfra: check the status of a submitted job returning not submitted, running, completed, or failed
